warRiskPremium.value: 3-10% of hull value · ~40-60x pre-crisis · FULL TRANSIT COST $10-20M/ship (ENOC, Sep 9) · cargo insurance 5-6% of cargo (up to 10% to exit) · claims >$2B across 70+ cases
warRiskPremium.value_zh: 船体价值3-10% · 约为战前40-60倍 · 单船全程成本$1000-2000万（ENOC，9月9日）· 货物险为货值5-6%（出港可达10%）· 理赔超$20亿、涉70+案例
warRiskPremium.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-13): TRANSIT COSTS RE-ESCALATED TO $10-20M PER SHIP. ENOC director Paul Bradshaw at APPEC (Sep 9, Reuters/Baird Maritime): full war-risk + cargo cost to move crude out of the Gulf has escalated into the $10 MILLION TO $20 MILLION PER SHIP range; cargo insurance now 5-6% of cargo value and up to 10% of cargo for exit cover (vs ~zero pre-war) — 'another $10 million on your cargo insurance'; SOME MARKET PARTICIPANTS ARE NOW TRANSITING WITH NO INSURANCE AT ALL; more national oil companies have taken their own shipping back in-house precisely so they retain the ability to exit during conflict; the pool of shipowners willing to take the risk is shrinking. Hull war-risk remains quoted in the 3-10% of hull value band (pre-war 0.25%) — a $100M tanker faces $3-10M of premium vs ~$250K before the war (The National/Marsh). Structural repricing permanent. Backdrop: Brent settled $101.21 on Sep 9 (first triple-digit close since July), $104.61 on Sep 11 — +9% w/w, +17.6% m/m, +56% YoY — after the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and Houthi advances on Bab el-Mandeb; IEA cut its 2026 global oil demand forecast by 2.5 mb/d (largest annual contraction since Covid). PRECEDING CONTEXT: Sept 1 'tanker-for-tanker' US strikes on Iranian government tankers halted the late-Aug premium easing (3-8%); claims from the conflict exceed $2B across 70+ cases — second-largest marine-insurer hit in a decade after the 2024 Baltimore bridge; ~$7-8/bbl of crude cost attributable to war-risk insurance; Lloyd's facing ~£1.4B in losses. High-risk zone extended ~800km north along Saudi Red Sea coast; charterers' liability standard cover has blanket exclusion for Saudi-linked vessels; Saudi seeking a state-backed guarantee scheme. De facto $3-10M toll per tanker persists. Updated 2026-09-13
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：全程通行成本重新升至每船$1000-2000万。ENOC董事Paul Bradshaw在APPEC（9月9日，路透/Baird Maritime）：把原油运出海湾的战争险+货物险总成本已升至每船1000万至2000万美元区间；货物险现为货值5-6%，出港保险可达货值10%（战前近零）——'你的货物险上又是1000万美元'；部分市场参与者现已完全无保险通行；更多国家石油公司把航运收回自营，正是为了在冲突时保留撤出能力；愿意承担风险的船东池在收缩。船体战争险仍在船体价值3-10%区间（战前0.25%）——一艘1亿美元油轮面临300万-1000万美元保费，战前约25万美元（The National/Marsh）。结构性重定价已属永久。背景：布伦特9月9日结算$101.21（7月以来首次三位数收盘），9月11日$104.61——周涨9%、月涨17.6%、年涨56%——此前沙特东西管道停运、胡塞向曼德海峡推进；IEA将2026年全球石油需求预测下调250万桶/天（疫情以来最大年度收缩）。前情：9月1日美方'以船换船'打击伊朗政府油轮，中止了8月底的保费回落（3-8%）；冲突理赔超$20亿、涉70+案例，为十年来仅次于2024年巴尔的摩大桥事件的第二大海事保险打击；每桶原油成本中约$7-8归因于战争险；劳合社面临约£14亿损失。高风险区域沿沙特红海海岸向北延伸约800公里；承租人标准责任险对沙特关联船只设全盘排除条款；沙特寻求国家担保机制。每艘油轮实际负担300-1000万美元过路成本。更新于 2026-09-13

straitThroughput.value: 7 transits Sep 9 (fell from 12 on Sep 8; 10-day avg 14 — Reuters) · JMIC avg ~23/day recent vs ~4.5/day July trough · US-escorted 65 over Aug 27-29 · vs pre-war ~138/day
straitThroughput.value_zh: 9月9日7艘（较9月8日12艘回落；10日均值14艘——路透）· JMIC近期均值约23艘/天 vs 7月低点约4.5艘/天 · 8月27-29日美方护航通行65艘 · 战前约138艘/天
straitThroughput.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-13): TRANSITS STILL SINGLE-DIGIT, DATA WAR INTACT. Reuters (Sep 10): vessel transits via Hormuz FELL to 7 on Wednesday Sep 9 from 12 the previous day — also below the 10-day average of 14. UANI/JMIC (Sep 11): 901 vessels have transited since June 18, 1,514 since the war began (pre-war baseline ~138/day); since the July low of ~4.5 transits/day the rate has recovered to an average of ~23/day — i.e. still ~83% below normal. USNI News (Sep 4): US-facilitated transits varied wildly — 65 over Aug 27-29 vs 37 over Aug 25-26; JMIC figures still do NOT match the Trump administration's 30-40 ships/day claim. Dark transits + ship-to-ship transfers are the workaround; ADNOC continues mainly-dark shuttle runs; many transiting ships are state-subsidised by Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar and Kuwait, whose sovereign backing lets them absorb the risk. Flows: dated Brent (the benchmark pricing ~two-thirds of supply) has been above $100 since Sep 3 (LSEG); Brent settled $101.21 Sep 9 (first triple-digit close since July) and $104.61 Sep 11 (+9% w/w). UKMTO continues to log incidents; JWC listing unchanged. PRECEDING CONTEXT: Kpler showed 4-6 commodity vessels/day Sep 1-3 vs ~14 late-Aug avg; PortWatch 6 transits vs ~85/day pre-crisis; ~450 vessels waiting. War-risk costs make many transits uneconomic. Updated 2026-09-13
straitThroughput.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：通行仍为个位数，'数据战'持续。路透（9月10日）：霍尔木兹通行量9月9日周三降至7艘，前一日为12艘——也低于10日均值14艘。UANI/JMIC（9月11日）：6月18日以来共901艘通行，战争以来累计1,514艘（战前基线约138艘/天）；自7月低点约4.5艘/天后，近一统计期回升至均值约23艘/天——即仍低于正常约83%。USNI News（9月4日）：美方护航通行波动极大——8月27-29日65艘 vs 8月25-26日37艘；JMIC数字仍与特朗普政府声称的30-40艘/天不符。暗航+船对船转运成为绕行方案；ADNOC继续以暗航穿梭为主；许多通行船由沙特、巴林、卡塔尔、科威特国家补贴，主权背书使其能承受风险。流量：定价约三分之二供应的即期布伦特自9月3日起持续高于$100（LSEG）；布伦特9月9日结算$101.21（7月以来首次三位数收盘），9月11日$104.61（周涨9%）。UKMTO持续记录事件；JWC名单未变。前情：Kpler显示9月1-3日4-6艘商品船/天 vs 8月底约14艘；PortWatch 6次通行 vs 战前约85艘/天；约450艘船滞留。战争险成本使多数过境在经济上不可行。更新于 2026-09-13

irgcStatementFreq.value: 20-30/week (crisis level) · Sep 8-9: US disabled 5 Iranian tankers, IRGC claimed hits on 2 US destroyers + 18 vessels · Al Azraq salvo (20 ballistic missiles, 18 intercepted)
irgcStatementFreq.value_zh: 20-30次/周（危机水平）· 9月8-9日：美方瘫痪5艘伊朗油轮，IRGC声称击中2艘美军驱逐舰+18艘船 · 阿兹拉克基地齐射（20枚弹道导弹，18枚被拦截）
irgcStatementFreq.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-13): HEAVIEST EXCHANGE OF THE WAR SINCE SEPT 1. Sep 7: Iran declared it would announce a Hormuz 'prohibited zone' within days. Sep 8: after the IRGC twice fired ballistic missiles at a US Navy warship over two days, CENTCOM DISABLED 5 Iranian tankers — Kaviz, Charminar, Horizon 1 and Risco in the Sea of Oman plus Darya near Kharg Island (crews evacuated first). Also Sep 8: IRGC announced it had SEIZED a US Navy unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) and published recovery footage; CENTCOM confirmed the drone was American but an older model with no sensitive sensors or classified kit, recovered after a technical malfunction. Sep 9 (dawn statement): IRGC claimed it had struck 2 US destroyers, 8 oil tankers and 10 other vessels in an operation named 'Punishing the Aggressors' — retaliation for the US strikes on Iranian tankers — and said the 10 were trying to transit the 'prohibited and unsafe' Hormuz zone under US escort (claims unconfirmed; no US confirmation of damage). Same statement announced a ballistic-missile salvo on Al Azraq airbase in Jordan targeting US F-35/F-16/F-15s: Jordan's armed forces said 20 missiles were fired, 18 intercepted and destroyed, 2 fell in unpopulated areas, no casualties. Rubio (Sep 8-9, Bogota): 'Iran continues to try to hit US naval ships, and for every time they do that or try to do that, they're going to lose tankers.' IRGC line unchanged: 'The Strait of Hormuz remains powerfully and authoritatively under the surveillance and control of the Navy of the IRGC.' Sep 12: Pezeshkian said the Pakistan/Oman tracks did not fail because of Tehran and Iran is ready to talk if Washington honours commitments (end sanctions, stop attacks); he confirmed Iran is negotiating with Oman on reopening the strait. IRGC-linked reporting also claims the IRGC seized a US 'unmanned submarine' at the strait entrance (CENTCOM: malfunctioned drone). Updated 2026-09-13
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：9月1日以来最激烈的交火。9月7日：伊朗称将在数日内宣布霍尔木兹'禁区'。9月8日：在IRGC两天内两次向美军军舰发射弹道导弹后，CENTCOM瘫痪了5艘伊朗油轮——阿曼湾的Kaviz、Charminar、Horizon 1、Risco，以及哈尔克岛附近的Darya（袭击前船员已撤离）。同日：IRGC宣布缴获一艘美国海军无人潜航器（UUV）并公布打捞画面；CENTCOM证实该潜航器属美方，但为旧型号、无敏感传感器或涉密设备，因技术故障被回收。9月9日（黎明声明）：IRGC声称在代号'惩罚侵略者'的行动中击中2艘美军驱逐舰、8艘油轮和10艘其他船只——作为对美方打击伊朗油轮的报复——并称这10艘船正试图在美国护航下穿越霍尔木兹'禁区和不安全区'（说法未获证实；美方未确认损害）。同一声明宣布向约旦阿兹拉克空军基地发射弹道导弹，目标为该基地的美军F-35/F-16/F-15：约旦武装部队称共发射20枚导弹，18枚被拦截摧毁，2枚落入无人区，无伤亡。鲁比奥（9月8-9日，波哥大）：'伊朗持续试图攻击美军军舰，他们每尝试一次，就会损失油轮。'IRGC口径不变：'霍尔木兹海峡依然强有力且权威地处于IRGC海军的监视与控制之下。'9月12日：佩泽希齐扬称巴基斯坦/阿曼轨道的失败不怪德黑兰，若华盛顿履行承诺（解除制裁、停止攻击）伊朗愿谈；他证实正与阿曼就重开海峡谈判。IRGC关联媒体还称IRGC在海峡入口缴获一艘美国'无人潜艇'（CENTCOM：故障无人机）。更新于 2026-09-13

fleetPosition.value: 5th Fleet HQ Bahrain damaged — Navy will NOT return 'anytime soon' (Adm. Caudle); base could not support USS Abraham Lincoln ops (Acting Navy Sec., Sep 11) · 'tanker-for-tanker' exchanges ongoing — US disabled 5 Iranian tankers Sep 8 · IRGC claims 2 US destroyers hit · CENTCOM still claims lanes open
fleetPosition.value_zh: 第五舰队巴林总部受损——海军称'短期内不会'返回（考德尔上将）；基地无法支持'林肯号'航母运作（代理海军部长，9月11日）· '以船换船'交火持续——美方9月8日瘫痪5艘伊朗油轮 · IRGC声称击中2艘美军驱逐舰 · CENTCOM仍称航道开放
fleetPosition.source: CNBC / Al Jazeera / CENTCOM / The National
fleetPosition.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-13): THE US NAVY HAS EFFECTIVELY LOST ITS BAHRAIN HUB. Acting Navy Secretary Cao (Sep 11) acknowledged Iranian attacks early in the war left the 5th Fleet headquarters at Naval Support Activity Bahrain damaged and UNABLE TO SUPPORT USS ABRAHAM LINCOLN OPERATIONS — the carrier crew had 'no place for them to pull in'; the Navy's top uniformed officer Adm. Daryl Caudle said the service would not return to NSA Bahrain 'anytime soon'. Iran publicly welcomed the admission (AA, Sep 11); open-source/satellite imagery had already indicated substantial damage. This is the biggest basing setback of the war and licenses sustained IRGC messaging about US force-posture vulnerability. Exchange tempo: the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US warship twice over Sep 7-8 (US: evaded, no damage); CENTCOM then disabled 5 Iranian tankers (Kaviz, Charminar, Horizon 1, Risco, Darya) — the 'tanker-for-tanker' policy in action, with Rubio promising more; the IRGC claimed 2 US destroyers and 18 vessels hit on Sep 9 and fired 20 ballistic missiles at Al Azraq, Jordan (18 intercepted). US-facilitated transits varied 37-65/day over Aug 25-29 (USNI) — far above independent tracker counts. CENTCOM (Adm. Cooper) still says lanes are 'open, momentum building'; independent trackers count 7-14/day. Iranian crude exports remain halted; ~86-87 Iranian-linked vessels rerouted since July; Treasury SDN'd Golden Global Bank (Sep 4) over conversion of Iranian oil proceeds into cash/gold. PRECEDING: first 'tanker-for-tanker' strikes on Iranian tankers Sep 1 + ~100-target package. Updated 2026-09-13
fleetPosition.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：美海军实际已失去巴林枢纽。代理海军部长（9月11日）承认战争初期伊朗袭击导致第五舰队巴林总部（NSA Bahrain）受损，且无法支持'林肯号'航母运作——航母舰员'无处靠泊'；海军最高军职官考德尔上将进一步表示短期内不会返回NSA Bahrain。伊朗公开欢迎美方这一承认（AA，9月11日）；此前的开源/卫星影像已显示该设施严重损毁。这是本次战争最大的基地 setback，为IRGC关于美军兵力姿态脆弱性的宣传提供了长期素材。交火节奏：IRGC在9月7-8日两天内两次向美军军舰发射弹道导弹（美方：已规避、无损伤）；CENTCOM随后瘫痪5艘伊朗油轮（Kaviz、Charminar、Horizon 1、Risco、Darya）——'以船换船'政策落地，鲁比奥承诺更多打击；IRGC 9月9日声称击中2艘美军驱逐舰和18艘船，并向约旦阿兹拉克发射20枚弹道导弹（18枚被拦截）。美方护航通行量8月25-29日波动于37-65艘/天（USNI）——远高于独立追踪源计数。CENTCOM（库珀上将）仍称航道'开放、势头向好'；独立追踪源计为7-14艘/天。伊朗原油出口仍停摆；7月以来约86-87艘伊朗关联船只改道；财政部9月4日将Golden Global Bank列入SDN，指其将伊朗石油收入转为现金和黄金。前情：9月1日首次'以船换船'打击伊朗油轮+约100目标打击包。更新于 2026-09-13

saudiUaeStance.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-13): ALLIANCE STRAIN BROADENING — SAUDI NOW SQUEEZED ON BOTH SIDES OF THE PENINSULA. Sep 10 (Thu): Saudi Arabia SHUT DOWN its East-West pipeline (745 miles/1,200km, built in the 1980s as the Hormuz bypass) after multiple drone strikes in the Riyadh and Medina regions — both Baghdad and Riyadh said the drones came from Iraq, where Iran-backed militias operate; several people injured; Iraq dismissed a military commander in response. The line had been moving 4-5 mb/d (4-5% of global supply) in recent months, per Kpler/analysts. Saudi said it would NOT retaliate for now at the Iraqi PM's request, reserving the right to act. Same window: Houthis seized the port city of Mokha and the Red Sea island of Perim, giving them control of Yemen's Red Sea coast and the Bab el-Mandeb gateway; the group says it is imposing an embargo on Saudi oil shipments and diplomats say it is eyeing a toll akin to Iran's. Kpler: Saudi oil exports to Asia fell from ~3.4 mb/d in June to 128K bpd in August, recovering to ~700K bpd this month. MBS called Trump at least twice on Sep 10 to request US military help against the Houthis (Reuters, confirming Axios); Washington declined direct military action for now, offering intelligence-sharing and targeting help only — the White House is 'not enthusiastic about getting involved'. Analysts (ACLED/Ratney): Saudi has fewer interceptors available because of the US-Iran conflict; Houthi weaponry is more sophisticated than a decade ago. UAE (Trade Minister Al Zeyoudi, Hili Forum, Sep 8): Hormuz is a 'red line' — 'no country owns the Strait of Hormuz, and no country should determine who can and can't access it'; Abu Dhabi is accelerating a PERMANENT shift away from Hormuz — east-coast ports Khor Fakkan and Fujairah, new logistics corridors via Oman's Sohar and Duqm, and a new pipeline to export Abu Dhabi crude via the Gulf of Oman; the June pledge to cut Hormuz dependency to 'zero' is no longer classed as a temporary workaround. Oil: Brent above $100 (dated Brent since Sep 3). Forward signal: GCC foreign ministers are due to meet Iran's counterpart in Oman on Monday Sep 14 to discuss a temporary shipping-management arrangement. PRECEDING: Saudi had pivoted ~1.9M bpd to Egypt's SUMED; Houthi blockade had cut Red Sea exports to 64K bpd in Aug. Updated 2026-09-13
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：同盟张力扩大——沙特在半岛两侧同时受压。9月10日（周四）：沙特在利雅得和麦地那地区遭多起无人机袭击后关闭东西管道（745英里/1200公里，1980年代为绕过霍尔木兹而建）——巴格达与利雅得均称无人机来自伊朗支持的民兵活动的伊拉克；数人受伤；伊拉克随后撤换一名军事指挥官。据Kpler/分析人士，该管道近月日均输送400-500万桶（占全球供应4-5%）。沙特表示应伊拉克总理请求暂不报复，但保留采取行动的权利。同一窗口：胡塞武装夺取港口城市摩卡和红海岛屿丕林岛，从而控制也门红海沿岸与曼德海峡门户；该组织称正对沙特石油出口实施禁运，外交人士称其正考虑征收类似伊朗的通行费。Kpler：沙特对亚洲石油出口从6月约340万桶/天降至8月的12.8万桶/天，本月回升至约70万桶/天。MBS 9月10日至少两次致电特朗普请求美军对胡塞提供军事支援（路透，证实Axios报道）；华盛顿暂拒直接军事行动，仅提供情报共享与目标定位支持——白宫'并不热衷于介入'。分析人士（ACLED/Ratney）：因美伊冲突，沙特可用拦截弹减少；胡塞武器较十年前更为先进。阿联酋（外贸部长Al Zeyoudi，Hili论坛，9月8日）：霍尔木兹是'红线'——'没有哪个国家拥有霍尔木兹海峡，也不应有国家决定谁能进出'；阿布扎比正加速永久性摆脱霍尔木兹——东岸的豪尔费坎和富查伊拉港、经阿曼苏哈尔和杜库姆的新物流走廊、以及经阿曼湾出口阿布扎比原油的新管道；6月提出的将霍尔木兹依赖降至'零'不再被列为临时权宜。油价：布伦特高于$100（即期布伦特自9月3日起）。前瞻信号：海湾合作委员会外长预计9月14日（周一）在阿曼与伊朗外长会面，讨论临时航运管理安排。前情：沙特此前已转经埃及SUMED输送约190万桶/天；胡塞封锁已使红海出口在8月降至6.4万桶/天。更新于 2026-09-13
